verification_report.summary: All supplied research-only supplements pass the strict sequential and reference checks. The bounded-root closure is proved in the stronger L^n+rho norm, with signed truncations and the exact dominated-convergence-in-measure criterion. The compact-current formula is extended from positive smooth to bounded measurable weights using subcritical determinant L^q estimates, and then to arbitrary L^n weights by monotone truncation with only the two permitted suprema. Uniform rho tails give finite upper-semicontinuous concave integrable-weight functionals, attainment, and uniformly integrable determinant-weighted densities. For D_omega^0 roots, the two-sign near-maximizer argument, matrix determinant concavity after established absolute continuity, uniform Taylor control, and separation yield precisely all supporting probabilities and the stated one-sided derivatives. The proof retains n>=2 for the current section and makes none of the excluded regularity, exact-equation, weak-linearization, prescribed-singularity, all-density, or novelty claims. All cited substantive results are supplied local checkpoint dependencies; no external-paper citation appears.
